opportunity: coreutils fmt -O2 calls one static function three times from main and kuna renders one, two and three arguments; the three-argument site reads two `// rdx` locals nothing assigns. The callee's own recovered prototype takes two parameters. `argclobber` fixed that in #652 but shipped OFF, because the only clause that could speak for the callee was a bounded walk of its entry, and four ordinary programs hide a real read from that walk (a jump table, the walk's instruction budget, a PLT import, a 16-byte rax:rdx struct return forwarded onward). With protoorder (#669) merged the callee's own RECOVERED prototype is readable at the call site, and it separates every shipped drop from every counterexample.
inspiration: coreutils fmt -O2 main 0x26a0 -> fmt 0x3700 at 0x2ac1; upstream ParamListStandardOut::fillinMap (fspec.cc:1721) and AncestorRealistic::enterNode (funcdata_varnode.cc:2043)

rule_change.admits: the callee's RECOVERED prototype (parked by `protoorder types`) exists for this entry and has no parameter overlapping the argument's register bytes
rule_change.vetoes: unchanged caller-side clauses, plus the bounded callee-entry walk (`proves_input`) demoted from admitting to vetoing
inert_where: kuna decompile (one function per forked process)
rule_change.value_naming: `on` now means the new rule; no `proto` value was added, because the old rule is unsound where they differ and identical where they do not

counterexamples.old_rule: all four lose the argument, and with it the expression that computed it
counterexamples.new_rule: all four are byte-identical to the option-off output

speed.decompile: scripts.pipeline.timeit --option argclobber, coreutils fmt O2 main @0x26a0, 15 samples: 227.21 -> 219.95 ms (-3.20%). `kuna decompile` forks one process per function, so nothing is parked and the rule is inert there; the callee-entry probe is no longer decoded for it either.
speed.decompile_all: interleaved min-of-15 whole-binary `kuna decompile-all --option argclobber off|on`, the surface where the rule fires: coreutils fmt O2 4274.3 -> 4268.6 ms (-0.13%) min / 4821.4 -> 4678.2 (-2.97%) median; coreutils ls O2 13804.1 -> 13963.0 (+1.15%) / 15347.0 -> 15451.7 (+0.68%); coreutils sort O2 14881.9 -> 14391.5 (-3.30%) / 16233.1 -> 16186.2 (-0.29%); bash O2 82369.0 -> 81401.9 (-1.17%) / 84724.9 -> 83883.5 (-0.99%)
speed.note: measured on a box shared with other campaign lanes; interleaved so load falls on both arms alike. The only positive delta (ls, +1.15% on the minimum) is inside its own median's noise (+0.68%).
